channel.title: Longevity Weekly
channel.description:
The science of aging, read carefully. Every Wednesday: the week's most useful aging research — exercise, sleep, diet, the biology and the tests — and one mechanism of aging explained properly — what it is, what the evidence shows in animals and in people, and what it does not show. Education only; never medical advice.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

item.title: Ep 2: Fourteen randomized trials showed resistance training raised handgrip strength in older…
item.description: Longevity Weekly Fourteen randomized trials showed resistance training raised handgrip strength in older adults with sarcopenia. What You Need to Know: Human randomized trials and meta-analyses demonstrate that resistance training improves muscle strength and physical performance measures such as gait speed in older adults with sarcopenia. These effects appear in both early and later stages of frailty. ...
